translations.text: I confess all my sins to God almighty, to all God's saints, and to you, man of God:
wrong thoughts, wrong words, wrong deeds; any wrong that I saw, any wrong that I heard, any wrong that I thought of, or that I enticed another to do;
whatever I did against God's will: false oaths, evil curses, lying, stealing, fornication, manslaughter, wrong counsel;
whether it befell me through my childishness, or through drunkenness, or through my own temptation, or through another man's enticement;
greed, envy, hatred, slander, evil desires; that I did not come to church as I rightly should have,
did not keep my fast as I rightly should have, did not give my alms as I rightly should have, did not reconcile two people at odds, did not forgive the sin of one whom I rightly should have forgiven;
that I did not honour holy days, Sundays, the holy Mass and the holy law as I rightly should have;
that I gave without permission, received without permission, ate at improper times, drank at improper times, slept at improper times, kept awake at improper times.
All this and much else in which I am guilty before God almighty: what I promised God almighty in my baptism as a Christian and knowingly abandoned, whether I remember it or do not remember it;
whether I thought it, whether I spoke it, whether I did it; whether it befell me sleeping or waking, walking, standing, sitting or lying:
all of this I confess to God almighty, to all God's saints, and to you, man of God, and I will willingly do penance from now on, as far as God almighty grants me strength and understanding.
Almighty Lord, grant us strength and understanding to do and to carry out your will, as it is your will. Amen.
